conventions.convention: Convex invariant domain means convexity and preservation by the specified one-step map on its stated admissible inputs; it asserts no invariance for other integrators or exact Riemann evolution.
The HLL update uses a periodic uniform mesh with N ≥ 2, ν = Δt/h ≥ 0, and supplied speeds S_L < 0 < S_R at each face. No exact nonlinear wave-speed enclosure is inferred.
Entropy gradients are columns: v = ∇η, ∇q = DFᵀv, and ψ = vᵀF − q. Convex entropy permits a positive-semidefinite Hessian.
The Tadmor identity uses right-minus-left jumps: (v_R − v_L)ᵀFᵉᶜ = ψ_R − ψ_L. Dissipation is subtracted as D(v_R − v_L)/2, with D symmetric positive semidefinite.
For γ > 1 and ε > 0, the Euler margin requires density ≥ ε and internal-energy density E − m²/(2ρ) ≥ ε; ε is not a pressure threshold.
The limiter takes a finite nonempty node set, positive weights summing to one, a closed convex set K, and a mean already in K. It returns the largest common feasible scaling parameter in [0,1].
The entropy theorem concerns differentiable semidiscrete trajectories remaining in the state domain; it supplies no fully discrete entropy inequality.

load_bearing.statement: Under 2ν(−S_L) ≤ 1 and 2νS_R ≤ 1, the adjacent half-cell averages are A⁻ = (1 − 2ν(−S_L))U_L + 2ν(−S_L)U_* and A⁺ = (1 − 2νS_R)U_R + 2νS_RU_*, where U_* = (S_RU_R − S_LU_L − (F_R − F_L))/(S_R − S_L). Every updated mean is (A⁺ at its left face + A⁻ at its right face)/2.
For γ > 1 and ε > 0, the ideal-gas admissible set and K_{γ,ε} are convex, and K_{γ,ε} is closed in R³.
For an ideal-gas admissible state U and a ≥ |u| + c, both U ± F(U)/a are admissible. With δ = ±1/a and x = 1 + δu, their density is ρx and their internal-energy density is ex − δ²p²/(2ρx) > 0.

A continuous two-point flux is entropy-conservative in Tadmor's sense if it is consistent and symmetric and satisfies (v_R − v_L)ᵀFᵉᶜ(U_L,U_R) = ψ_R − ψ_L for every pair of states in the domain. No existence for a prescribed entropy pair is asserted.

For convex K and cell means in K, one first-order HLL update remains in K if both adjacent half-cell fan averages at every face lie in K under the local CFL bounds. Membership of every HLL intermediate state in K is sufficient for this hypothesis.

Differentiable periodic finite-volume states remaining in the entropy domain and using the specified dissipative flux satisfy the local cell entropy inequality with numerical entropy flux ((v_i + v_{i+1})/2)ᵀFᵉˢ − (ψ_i + ψ_{i+1})/2. Total discrete entropy is nonincreasing. No fully discrete conclusion is asserted.

For finite positively weighted Euler candidate nodes whose mean lies in K_{γ,ε}, maximal convex scaling is well-defined, preserves the weighted mean, and places every output node in K_{γ,ε}. It is inactive when all candidate nodes are already admissible, including under the stated strict target-margin and reconstruction-error condition. No positivity between nodes is claimed.
